messages:
maria: quick flag from onboarding tests — SDKs return different error shapes for identical runtime failures (py: AuthExpired, go: raw 401 string, js: nested object). makes retry/UX handling brittle. can we agree a tiny canonical error JSON + language-idiomatic typed exceptions that wrap it?

alex: yes. runtime emits canonical JSON, SDKs map to native exceptions and attach the raw body. keeps ergonomics and debuggability.

sam: proposed canonical fields: `type`, `status`, `message`, `error_class`, `retryable`, `retry_after_seconds`, `hint_code`, `documentation_url`. minimal and actionable.

linda: agree. suggested `error_class` enums: auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient_server. apps switch on that instead of brittle codepoints.

maria: streaming note: for mid-stream failures include same body + optional `stream_resume_token`/`stream_offset`. SDKs expose StreamInterruptedError with resume metadata.

qa-bot: test plan: add CI matrix that posts canonical payloads to runtime dev endpoint and asserts each SDK surfaces `error_class`, `retryable`, and exposes `raw_error`. run nightly.

maria: short example for SDK README: 
```json
{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Too many requests",
  "error_class": "rate_limit",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "hint_code": "reduce_concurrency",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit"
}
```

alex: runtime mapping draft: 400->user_input(false); 401/403->auth/permission(false); 404->not_found(false); 409->conflict(false); 429->rate_limit(true, use `Retry-After` header); 5xx->transient_server(true).

linda: tiny copy note: separate developer logs vs end-user strings. dev: `AuthError: token expired (401)`; UI: `Session expired — please sign in again.`

maria: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC + sample SDK patches. volunteers to coauthor? @alex (go/java), @linda (js/docs), @sam (runtime tests).

alex: i'll take go SDK changes.

linda: i'll do js + docs.

sam: i'll add runtime tests and CI gating.

maria: opening tracking ticket DX-ERR-2700 and linking RFC. thanks everyone :rocket:

jira-bot: Created ticket DX-ERR-2700: "Canonical SDK error shape + typed exceptions" assigned to maria, alex, linda, sam.
